questions.question: List all active customers from Japan, showing their name, email, and city.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT name, email, city FROM customers WHERE country = 'Japan' AND is_active = true ORDER BY name;
questions.description: Simple query with text and boolean filters

questions.question: Which products are currently available with a price less than $200, showing their names and prices?
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE is_available = true AND price < 200.00 ORDER BY price;
questions.description: Simple query with basic boolean and numeric comparison filters

questions.question: Show all suppliers from Brazil, including their name, contact name, and email.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT name, contact_name, email FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Brazil' ORDER BY name;
questions.description: Simple query with text filter and ordering

questions.question: List all orders with status 'cancelled', showing the order ID, customer ID, total amount, and order date.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT order_id, customer_id, total_amount, order_date FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY order_date DESC;
questions.description: Simple query with enum filter and date ordering

questions.question: Which products belong to the 'laptops' category, showing their names and prices?
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT p.name, p.price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'laptops' ORDER BY p.price;
questions.description: Simple query with single JOIN and filter

questions.question: What is the total revenue generated by each payment method, excluding cancelled orders, showing the payment method, total revenue, and order count?
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT payment_method, SUM(total_amount) as total_revenue, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
questions.description: Moderate query with aggregation and GROUP BY

questions.question: List the top 10 customers by total spending, showing their name, email, and total amount spent, excluding cancelled orders.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT c.name, c.email, SUM(o.total_amount) as total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.email ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;
questions.description: Moderate query with JOIN, aggregation and limit

questions.question: What is the average product price per category, showing the category name, average price, and product count?
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT c.name as category, AVG(p.price) as avg_price, COUNT(p.product_id) as product_count FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
questions.description: Moderate query with JOIN and aggregation

questions.question: Show all products that have received at least one review with rating 5, showing their names and prices.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.name, p.price FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.rating = 5 ORDER BY p.name;
questions.description: Moderate query with JOIN and filter using DISTINCT

questions.question: List suppliers who provide products in the 'smartphones' category.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT DISTINCT s.name, s.email, s.country FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'smartphones' ORDER BY s.name;
questions.description: Moderate query with multiple JOINs and DISTINCT

questions.question: What is the average number of items per order, showing the average item count across all orders?
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT AVG(item_count) as avg_items_per_order FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) as item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) as order_counts;
questions.description: Moderate query with subquery and aggregation

questions.question: Show products with stock quantity below 100 units, giving me their names, stock quantities, and categories.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT p.name, p.stock_quantity, c.name as category FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.stock_quantity < 100 ORDER BY p.stock_quantity ASC;
questions.description: Moderate query with JOIN and numeric filter

questions.question: List the average discount percentage applied per product category, showing the category name and average discount.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT c.name as category, AVG(oi.discount) as avg_discount FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_discount DESC;
questions.description: Moderate query with multiple JOINs and aggregation

questions.question: What are the top 5 most reviewed products and their average ratings, including product names, review counts, and average ratings?
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT p.name, COUNT(r.review_id) as review_count, AVG(r.rating) as avg_rating FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY review_count DESC, avg_rating DESC LIMIT 5;
questions.description: Complex query with JOIN, multiple aggregations and ordering

questions.question: Find customers who have placed more than 3 orders and their total spending, showing their names, emails, order counts, and total spent amounts.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT c.name, c.email, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status != 'cancelled' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.email HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 3 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
questions.description: Complex query with JOIN, aggregation and HAVING clause

questions.question: List the monthly order volume and total revenue for the last 6 months, showing the month, order count, and revenue.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) as month, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(total_amount) as monthly_revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) ORDER BY month DESC;
questions.description: Complex query with date functions and temporal aggregation

questions.question: Which products have never been ordered, showing their names, prices, and categories?
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT p.name, p.price, c.name as category FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items) ORDER BY p.name;
questions.description: Complex query with NOT IN subquery

questions.question: Calculate the revenue contribution of each category to the total revenue, showing the category name, revenue amount, and percentage of total revenue.
questions.expectedSQL: WITH category_revenue AS (SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount / 100)) as revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.name), total_revenue AS (SELECT SUM(revenue) as total FROM category_revenue) SELECT cr.name, cr.revenue, (cr.revenue / tr.total * 100) :: numeric(10, 2) as percentage FROM category_revenue cr CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr ORDER BY percentage DESC;
questions.description: Complex query with CTEs and percentage calculation

questions.question: Show the top 3 best-selling products per category based on quantity sold, displaying the category name, product name, and total quantity sold.
questions.expectedSQL: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT c.name as category, p.name as product, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_sold, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) as rank FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name, p.name) SELECT category, product, total_sold FROM product_sales WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY category, rank;
questions.description: Complex query with window functions and CTE

questions.question: Identify customers who made their first purchase in the last 30 days, showing their names, emails, registration dates, and first order dates.
questions.expectedSQL: SELECT c.name, c.email, c.registration_date, MIN(o.order_date) as first_order_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.email, c.registration_date HAVING MIN(o.order_date) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY first_order_date DESC;
questions.description: Complex query with aggregation and HAVING with date filter
